name: Harsh
about: 24, product and motion designer working in a Bengaluru office. Rides an Ather to work. Builds side projects at night: this creature, a code-CAD engine, 3D prints. Speaks English and Hindi. Makes content and wants to build in public.
rhythm: Ather to office ~9:30 on office days
meetings and design crits late morning
lunch around 1:30, often skipped when busy
ride home ~7, traffic mood depends on rain
dinner: cook or Zepto/Swiggy, often late
side-project and motion work 10 pm–1 am
sleep late on weekdays, catch up on Sunday
